records.title: Third-part airfield and German troop report
records.header_literal: B) ZON v UKS (10.04 p.m., November 7th); 3 TL RICHI-172
records.readable_german: Anscheinend dort Flugplatz. 2. In Linie MIROC BRZAPALANKA sichern nur noch deutsche Truppen.
records.meaning: This surviving third part says there apparently is an airfield at the previously mentioned place. Its next item says that only German troops still provide security along the line designated MIROC and the proposed BRZAPALANKA label. The earlier place reference and precise geographical identification are not supplied.
notes: The printed body is explicitly 3 TL and has exactly its advertised 172 occupied slots. This edition identifies no preceding first or second part and does not join the fragment to a different report by geographical resemblance.
The source has ADX-F and DXU-X: two printed dashes and a U-like non-coordinate glyph occupy three slots. All three are masked in the raw layer and filled explicitly.

The BR?APALANKA proposal is not a free fill: the raw pair G? has domain {0, 3, 6, O, Q, Y}, which excludes Z. BRZAPALANKA additionally requires source107 G→F, together with the source-glyph fill. The place spelling remains an editorial proposal.
TRUPPEL to TRUPPEN is the other observed-coordinate substitution. The item label 2 and MIROC remain literal.
The Nov4–6 key is unchanged. Its successful decryption does not alter the printed November7 header or establish the original drafting date.
